 Zane Gonzalez misses field goal in Week 9 
 by Chris Schommer | Dolphins Correspondent | Sun, Nov 8th 2026, 4:18pm EST 
 Zane Gonzalez converted 3-of-4 field goal attempts to finish with nine points in the Dolphins' 19-9 loss to the Lions in Week 9. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Gonzalez has battled consistency issues of late, missing one field goal attempt in each of his last two contests. The kicker will look to get back on track against the Indianapolis Colts in Week 10.
